ideas.pitch: An AI-powered transit route and rider allocation platform that optimizes local community shuttle services for underserved neighborhoods in San Francisco, matching senior citizens with vetted volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: BayArea-Transit-Equity-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets clear measurable social impact and replicates the exact pattern of community-focused logistics that won the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A predictive machine learning dashboard using spatial-temporal regression to forecast urban infrastructure anomalies and public safety incidents across San Francisco districts.
ideas.title: SF-Incident-Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: It showcases genuinely hard engineering through predictive modeling and robust data pipelines, mirroring the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winning profile.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace specifically tailored for local San Francisco pop-up vendors and gig workers, featuring automated USDC escrow payments and instant verification.
ideas.title: Bay-Area-Vendor-Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: It directly implements the winning formula of combining autonomous AI agents with crypto escrow rails seen at the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient acquisition and trust engine designed for urban wellness and specialized clinics in San Francisco, automating intake, personalized care plans, and local reputation management.
ideas.title: Soma-Health-Trust
ideas.why_it_could_win: It provides a clear economic benefit to local service businesses and follows the proven blueprint of the Elevate X hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and aerial monitoring tool that scans industrial zones along the San Francisco Bay for environmental compliance and land use infractions.
ideas.title: EcoCompliant-SF
ideas.why_it_could_win: It applies complex geospatial computer vision to solve a hard regulatory compliance problem, mirroring the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up.
